sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Buca revolve around the objective of getting a puck into a hole. Sounds simple, right? Well, it's not as easy as it seems. The game requires players to drag back, aim, and release the puck at the right angle to get it into the hole. The puck's trajectory is determined by the speed and angle at which it is released, making every shot a unique and challenging experience.

One of the key features of Buca is its physics-based gameplay. The puck's movement is affected by gravity, friction, and other environmental factors, making every shot a unique and unpredictable experience. This adds a layer of complexity to the game, requiring players to adapt their strategies and techniques to succeed.

Players can adjust the speed and angle of the puck by dragging their finger or mouse across the screen. The game also features a rewind feature, allowing players to retry their shots without losing progress. This feature is particularly useful for players who are struggling to master the game's mechanics.
